About

I'm Shreyas, a game developer studying for a BCA in Game Development at Ajeenkya DY Patil University, Pune (graduating TODO year). I work mostly in Unity with C#, and I also write C++.

I think making games is art, and the best part of any art is when someone understands it and enjoys it. A game is the one medium where people don't only look at your work, they play it. That is what I'm after: something people have fun with and remember.

What shapes how I design

Contra and Super Contra, A Way Out and Helldivers taught me how good a game feels when two people share it. Florence showed me that a game can be about feeling something instead of winning. GTA and Minecraft are systems that give players room to make their own stories. I try to build the second kind of thing, with the warmth of the first.

What I do on a team

I come up with mechanics, prototype them quickly, and hand them to programmers with clear intent, as I did on Plateformer. When I work alone, as on FairShots, I build the whole thing myself and spend the last hours on game feel.
